_comment: SPEC4 BIRTH (studies/reuse/SPEC4_birth.md §9), O7 allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B, ten checkpoint loads (T_15, T_5, T_6..T_13) run by infra.aws_pg.jobs.pipeline on infra/aws_pg/steps/reuse_birth.json, uploaded to steps_s3 unchanged (every S3 path in it is already under results/mdl/, and --from-step names /workspace/out/birth/t15, this cell's T_15 step directory, because run_cells.py uploads a cell's outputs only when the cell ends). Estimate about 123,500 forwards (87,974 readouts and 35,567 captures counted from the items; SPEC4 §11), 10 loads, about 0.8 h billed; max_billed_h 3 is the spec's cap. gpu_query holds the hard requirements of §9 that vast's query can express (GPU memory >= 32 GB, one GPU, compute capability >= 8.0, CUDA >= 13.0, host RAM >= 32 GB; the query compares gpu_ram and cpu_ram in GB, the raw offer JSON reports them in MB); the controller adds the base filter and disk_space; the CMP exclusion and the frozen price rule are applied to the raw offers by studies/reuse/scripts/offers_birth.py. Checkpoints (14.9 GB each) are downloaded in-run into HF_HUB_CACHE and deleted after each load; weights_mode download requires inet_down >= 800. pg_git_sha a4031bebc is the merge commit that holds every job module shipped; this manifest commit changes no code.
_watch_amendment: 2026-11-02 17:45Z, coordinator: max_billed_h raised from 3 to 3.9 h during the run because the host's downloads run 6 to 15 minutes per checkpoint (probe 28.6 MB/s); 3.9 h x $0.756/h = $2.95, inside the $3.00 cap of SPEC4 section 9; no other field changed.
